findings.title: Operator real live canary has not run in this session
findings.impact: Automated live acceptance cannot be closed until a real provider, Hunt, fetch, SourceObservation, index, restart, and local retrieval proof succeeds.
findings.required_next_step: Run OPERATOR-LIVE-CANARY-00 with a local Brave key and sanitized evidence output.

findings.title: Human product acceptance has not started
findings.impact: No operator verdict exists for usefulness, usability, ranking, error clarity, or whether Eureka should be used for real unknowns.
findings.required_next_step: Run the human rehearsal after the operator canary passes and record an explicit human verdict.

findings.title: Full unittest discovery is waiting for external execution
findings.impact: Promotion-scale unittest evidence is not available inside this AI session by policy.
findings.required_next_step: Run the external full-discovery handoff command outside the repo and return compact summary artifacts.

findings.title: Portable bundle rehearsal is a local source-checkout rehearsal
findings.impact: The bundle proves local manifest, checksums, launchers, bootstrap, backup, and restore, not a third-party clean machine install.
findings.required_next_step: Use external CI or an operator clean machine before any release claim.

findings.title: Foundry live operation remains disabled until live acceptance
findings.impact: Foundry deterministic controls are present, but live scheduled growth is not activated before the canary.
findings.required_next_step: Keep explicit local operator activation only after live acceptance.

findings.title: Performance baseline is deterministic and small in-session
findings.impact: The baseline captures local hot-path behavior without making a production scale claim.
findings.required_next_step: Run larger synthetic sizes on operator hardware when capacity tuning is needed.

findings.title: Public service remains out of scope
findings.impact: No public launch readiness is claimed; public live fanout and public mutation remain disabled.
findings.required_next_step: Return to public-readiness work only after live product acceptance.
